# North Stardust

> North Stardust is an independent creative studio and a home for original Intellectual Property, developed as a long-term creative practice exploring ideas, worlds and publishing. It is led by Athanasios Zagkliveris, Founder and Creative Director.

## Pages

- [Home](https://northstardust.studio/): The studio's hero statement and an introduction to its focus — The Studio, The Compass and The Horizon.
- [Contact](https://northstardust.studio/contact): Meet Athanasios Zagkliveris, Founder and Creative Director of North Stardust, and get in touch about a project, collaboration or idea.
- [Publishing](https://northstardust.studio/publishing): North Stardust's published work. Coming soon.
